newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Barilla sells Spanish pasta factory.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Barilla sells Spanish pasta factory.

text.p: Italy's largest food group, privately-owned Barilla, said it had decided to sell the Zaragoza pasta factory which it bought at the end of the 1980s.
Barilla said in a statement that a preliminary contract had been signed with Oromas of Barcelona.

The Italian group confirmed its interest in Spain, its seventh largest European market, but said the size of the Zaragoza plant was not adequate to cope with the positive trend in Spanish consumption.
The group said terms of the deal, part of Barilla's "optimisation plan", will be announced at a later date.
Barilla reported a fall in 1995 net profits to 73 billion lire from 111 billion lire in 1994, due to a fall in retails pasta prices and a rise in raw material costs. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
